G.SUDHAKAR RAO and S.B.GAONKAR 
India Meteorological Department, New Delhi 
Abstract 
Meteorological studies conducted at Maitri during 1994 are discussed in brief. August 
was the coldest month with lowest monthly mean air temperature -26.0 Deg C and extreme 
lowest air temperature -29.1 Deg C of the year. The occurrence of maximum and minimum 
pressure are having a clear tendency. Strongest wind of 65 knots gusting to about 80 kts was 
recorded during August. Cloud, precipitation, Aurora global solar radiation and net terres-
trial radiation are also discussed in brief.
